answer: The quartz test I would run is Proof of unique contractor licence with labour department attestation: a licence the labour department renews after site inspections and audits, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The economics flip: the network spends pennies verifying, the attacker spends real money proving, and the dawn of that gap is the whole defence in one line. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the tundra of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
